description: Pinned Dark Reader core with desktop output colors, compared with the preceding independent renderer. All samples and disabled controls are retained.

methodology.fixture: Production Chromium extension, trusted input, four deterministic scenarios, one worker, no retries.
methodology.limitations: Local samples do not establish live-site or Firefox extension latency. Uncollected JS heap is not retained heap. Main-thread busy values cover a complete phase, not a keypress.

liveDiagnostic.methodology: One fresh anonymous Chromium profile per variant; diagnostic observations, not latency guarantees. Phases retain partial data on errors. No search submission.
